title: Improve proposal detail review layout and disabled action explanations
description:
Problem: the selected `/proposals` review showed the proposal detail pane squeezed beneath recent maintenance activity and proposal rows. The summary/diff/review tabs and action controls are visible only in a short scroll area, and disabled actions such as approve/respond/reject do not explain why they are unavailable for an already rejected proposal.

Desired outcome: selecting a proposal should make the review target, state, summary, diff/evidence, comments, and available actions immediately understandable.

Scope:
- In scope: selected proposal detail layout, action bar placement, disabled action tooltips/reasons, rejected/approved state explanation, and summary/diff/evidence tab prioritization.
- Out of scope: changing proposal apply/reject semantics or maintenance generation behavior.

Acceptance criteria:
- Selected proposal detail receives enough first-viewport space to review the summary and state.
- Disabled actions explain the current state or required prerequisite.
- The current proposal status and allowed next actions are visually obvious.
- Diff/evidence/comments remain reachable without burying the review action area.

Validation:
- Capture `/proposals` with an open, approved, and rejected proposal where fixture data permits.
- Run focused browser checks for selecting a proposal, reading disabled-action labels/tooltips, and switching detail tabs.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Created from 2026-05-25 deeper live review: selected proposal detail was compressed below maintenance context, and disabled review actions did not explain their disabled state.
